input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 is the only ownership provision. It gives Garman ownership of all IP in the Work including the Schedule "D" Modifications we pay for, and sweeps in "all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement" without limiting that to Garman-supplied materials — which on its face could capture our own materials and the data Garman converts under Section 4(b). There is no statement anywhere in the Agreement that we retain rights in our data. Garman keeping its platform is acceptable, but the fallback is not met either: the only licence back (Section 2) is a non-exclusive, non-transferable use licence tied to Authorized Locations and continued fee payment, with no modify or sublicence rights and no express coverage of the funded Modifications. Redline limits Garman's ownership claim to its own materials, adds a Customer-data ownership sentence, and adds a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the Modifications we fund; we have not sought assignment of the Modifications given the packaged-software bargain and the Section 16 source code arrangements.

proposal.summary: Limit Garman's ownership claim to its own materials, confirm Sparkling owns its data, and add a perpetual licence to Modifications we pay for
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have limited Garman's ownership statement to its own materials and confirmed that we retain all rights in our data (including data converted under Section 4), since our playbook does not permit any assignment of our data or materials to a vendor. We are content for Garman to keep its platform, but we need a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the Modifications we fund.

ops.oldText: including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
ops.newText: including all related materials, logos, and names provided by Garman pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.

ops.text: Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data (including data converted pursuant to Section 4) and all materials, information and intellectual property provided or made available by Sparkling under this Agreement, and nothing in this Agreement operates to assign or transfer any such rights to Garman. Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, and to have modified for Sparkling's internal business purposes, the Modifications and any other customisations paid for by Sparkling.
